SysDataModelXML.SQLScript: SELECT TOP (1000) S.[ID] LINKROWID ,S.[DOCNUM] ,S.[DOCGRP] ,DOCGRP.OPTDES [DOCGRPDES] ,S.[DOCSTA] ,DOCSTA.OPTDES [DOCSTADES] ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.DOCDAT, 23) [DOCDAT] ,S.[WFLSTA] ,WFLSTA.OPTDES [WFLSTADES] ,S.[DOCDES] ,S.[SITE] ,SI.SITENAM ,S.[DEPT] ,DE.DEPTNAM ,CASE WHEN Isnull(S.CLRSTA, 0) = 0 THEN '否' WHEN Isnull(S.CLRSTA, 0) = 1 THEN '是' END CLRSTADES ,S.[GRP] ,GR.GRPNAM ,S.[RESNO] ,RE.RESNAM ,S.[PRJNUM] ,S.[BPSNO] ,BP.BPSNAM ,S.[CUR] ,S.[CURRAT] ,S.[BVATTYP] ,S.[SRCTYP] ,S.[SRCDOC] ,S.[SRCLIN] ,S.[REMARK] ,S.[CLOREA] ,S.[PRNCNT] ,S.[SSCO] ,S.[BLNO] ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, S.[ETD], 23) [ETD] ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, S.[ETA], 23) [ETA] ,S.[INVNO] ,S.[INVAMT] ,S.[PACQTY] ,S.[LCDOX] ,S.[COPHYTOFUMI] ,S.[HVI] ,S.[PLACEORI] ,PLACEORI.OPTDES [PLACEORIDES] ,S.[CONTROLLER] ,S.[CREUSR] ,S.[UPDUSR] ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.CRETIM, 21) CRETIM ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.UPDTIM, 21) UPDTIM FROM [PBOLH] S INNER JOIN ENTSITE SI ON SI.SITE = S.SITE LEFT JOIN ENTDEPT DE ON DE.DEPT = S.DEPT LEFT JOIN ENTGRP GR ON GR.GRP = S.GRP LEFT JOIN ENTRES RE ON RE.RESNO = S.RESNO LEFT JOIN BPSUP BP ON BP.[BPSNO] = S.[BPSNO] LEFT JOIN LINKOPT DOCGRP ON DOCGRP.OPTID = S.DOCGRP AND DOCGRP.OPTTYP = 'DOCGRP' AND DOCGRP.LINKOPTID = 'POR' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT DOCSTA ON DOCSTA.OPTID = S.DOCSTA AND DOCSTA.OPTTYP = 'DOCSTA' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT WFLSTA ON WFLSTA.OPTID = S.WFLSTA AND WFLSTA.OPTTYP = 'WFLSTA' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT PLACEORI ON PLACEORI.OPTID = S.PLACEORI AND PLACEORI.OPTTYP = 'PLACEORI' LEFT JOIN LINK.DBO.SYSUSER USR ON S.CREUSR = USR.LOGINUSER WHERE ( S.CREUSR = N'#LOGIN_USER#' --用户自己 OR '#LINKUSER(#LOGIN_USER#).DOCGRP#' = '' OR Charindex(USR.UDF001, '#LINKUSER(#LOGIN_USER#).DOCGRP#') > 0 ) --用户组权限 AND S.DOCNUM + S.BLNO + S.INVNO + S.BPSNO + Isnull(BP.BPSNAM, '') LIKE '%{0}%' AND S.DOCDAT BETWEEN '{1}' AND '{2}' AND S.DOCSTA LIKE '%{3}%' AND ( S.CREUSR = '{4}' OR '{4}' = '' ) AND ( S.CLRSTA = '{5}' OR '{5}' = '' ) ORDER BY S.ID DESC
SysDataModelXML.SQLUpdateScript: --LINKADDNEWROWS --LINKAUTOREPLACEEMPTYCOLUMNS MERGE INTO [PREQAH] D USING ( SELECT N'@DOCNUM@' DOCNUM ,N'@DOCGRP@' DOCGRP ,N'1' DOCSTA ,N'SAVED' WFLSTA ,N'@DOCDAT@' DOCDAT ,N'@DOCDES@' DOCDES ,N'@PRJNUM@' PRJNUM ,N'@SITE@' SITE ,N'@DEPT@' DEPT ,N'@GRP@' GRP ,N'@RESNO@' RESNO ,N'@REMARK@' REMARK ,N'@CLOREA@' CLOREA , N'#LOGIN_USER#' CREUSR , GETDATE() CRETIM ) S ON (S.[DOCNUM] = D.[DOCNUM]) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET DOCNUM = S.DOCNUM ,DOCGRP = S.DOCGRP ,DOCDAT = S.DOCDAT ,DOCDES = S.DOCDES ,PRJNUM = S.PRJNUM ,SITE = S.SITE ,DEPT = S.DEPT ,GRP = S.GRP ,RESNO = S.RESNO ,REMARK = S.REMARK ,CLOREA = S.CLOREA ,UPDUSR='#LOGIN_USER#' ,UPDTIM=GETDATE() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (DOCNUM ,DOCGRP ,DOCSTA ,WFLSTA ,DOCDAT ,DOCDES ,PRJNUM ,SITE ,DEPT ,GRP ,RESNO ,REMARK ,CLOREA ,CREUSR ,CRETIM ) VALUES ( S.DOCNUM ,S.DOCGRP ,S.DOCSTA ,S.WFLSTA ,S.DOCDAT ,S.DOCDES ,S.PRJNUM ,S.SITE ,S.DEPT ,S.GRP ,S.RESNO ,S.REMARK ,S.CLOREA ,S.CREUSR ,S.CRETIM );
SysDataModelXML.SQLNew: --LINKADDNEWROWS --LINKAUTOREPLACEEMPTYCOLUMNS MERGE INTO [PREQAH] D USING ( SELECT N'@DOCNUM@' DOCNUM ,N'@DOCGRP@' DOCGRP ,N'1' DOCSTA ,N'SAVED' WFLSTA ,N'@DOCDAT@' DOCDAT ,N'@DOCDES@' DOCDES ,N'@PRJNUM@' PRJNUM ,N'@SITE@' SITE ,N'@DEPT@' DEPT ,N'@GRP@' GRP ,N'@RESNO@' RESNO ,N'@REMARK@' REMARK ,N'@CLOREA@' CLOREA , N'#LOGIN_USER#' CREUSR , GETDATE() CRETIM ) S ON (S.[DOCNUM] = D.[DOCNUM]) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET DOCNUM = S.DOCNUM ,DOCGRP = S.DOCGRP ,DOCDAT = S.DOCDAT ,DOCDES = S.DOCDES ,PRJNUM = S.PRJNUM ,SITE = S.SITE ,DEPT = S.DEPT ,GRP = S.GRP ,RESNO = S.RESNO ,REMARK = S.REMARK ,CLOREA = S.CLOREA ,UPDUSR='#LOGIN_USER#' ,UPDTIM=GETDATE() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (DOCNUM ,DOCGRP ,DOCSTA ,WFLSTA ,DOCDAT ,DOCDES ,PRJNUM ,SITE ,DEPT ,GRP ,RESNO ,REMARK ,CLOREA ,CREUSR ,CRETIM ) VALUES ( S.DOCNUM ,S.DOCGRP ,S.DOCSTA ,S.WFLSTA ,S.DOCDAT ,S.DOCDES ,S.PRJNUM ,S.SITE ,S.DEPT ,S.GRP ,S.RESNO ,S.REMARK ,S.CLOREA ,S.CREUSR ,S.CRETIM );
SysDataModelXML.SQLRemove: DELETE FROM PREQAH WHERE DOCNUM='#DOCNUM#' AND DOCSTA='1';
